root_idea.summary: The root centers on submission, obedience, and being subject to an order or obligation.
root_idea.development: From this orientation develop obedience and religious adherence, prescribed law, requital and accountability, and financial obligation; related derived forms extend to authority, subjection, and reciprocal credit.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form دانَ.
Displayed as the reciprocal Form VI verb تَدَايَنَ.
Displayed as the nominal citation form دَيْنٌ.
Displayed as the nominal citation form دِينٌ.
The Quranic plural passive participle is normalized to the supported singular citation form مَدِينٌ.

senses.definition: To obey, submit to, or follow and adopt as one's religion.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the verb appears in the construction of following or adhering to the true religion.

senses.definition: To transact with one another on credit, whether by lending, borrowing, or buying and selling with deferred payment.
senses.usage_conditions: A reciprocal construction; in the Quranic usage it concerns a debt to be settled at an appointed term.

senses.definition: A debt or financial obligation to be discharged.
senses.usage_conditions: It may denote an amount owed under a loan, sale, inheritance settlement, or other deferred obligation, especially one assigned a time for payment.

senses.definition: Obedience, submission, and service directed to God.
senses.usage_conditions: This sense emphasizes the act or state of obeying and submitting, including sincere religious devotion.

senses.definition: Religion: an adopted system of belief, worship, and religious commitment, especially Islam.
senses.usage_conditions: It can refer to one's religion, the true religion, or the religion prescribed for a community; grammatical inflection and attached pronouns do not create separate senses.

senses.definition: A law, statute, ordinance, or ruling governing a particular matter.
senses.usage_conditions: This construction can refer either to divinely prescribed religious ordinances or, as in the Quranic account of Joseph, to the governing law or ruling of a particular authority.

senses.definition: Requital, judgment, reckoning, or recompense for deeds.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for the day or event on which actions are assessed and their corresponding consequences are rendered; the result may be translated as judgment, recompense, or requital.

senses.definition: Subject to requital, judgment, or reckoning; recompensed for one's deeds.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic contexts, the passive participle describes people who will be brought to account or requited.

senses.definition: Held under authority or ownership; subject or enslaved.
senses.usage_conditions: This Quranic interpretation presents the participle as denoting one held in another's possession or dominion; the same occurrence also has an attested alternative interpretation referring to requital.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To disobey.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An opposed Form I usage contrasted with obedience.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become mighty, powerful, elevated in rank, noble, or illustrious.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary development reported alongside the meanings of obedience and submission.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To borrow, incur a debt, or buy on credit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive financial use; the person becomes indebted or takes a loan or goods on credit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lend, grant a loan, give credit, or sell on credit; also to seek or receive a loan.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The transitive use has several reciprocal or oppositional valencies, including granting credit and seeking or receiving a loan.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To repay, requite, compensate, recompense, or retaliate for an act.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is repaid or treated in accordance with a prior deed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To reckon with oneself or hold oneself to account.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the maxim concerning the intelligent person who assesses himself and prepares for what follows death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abase, enslave, subjugate, or compel someone to do what he dislikes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use involving subjection or compulsion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rule, govern, manage, possess, or exercise authority over someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is placed under the speaker's or ruler's management, possession, or authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become accustomed or habituated, or to accustom oneself, to good or evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Some authorities treat دِينٌ in the sense of habit as a noun without assigning it a corresponding verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be smitten or affected by a disease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily-affliction use applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To leave someone to his religion and refrain from opposing what he considers permissible.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II causative use of allowing a person to retain his religious practice or belief.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To believe or credit someone in a judgment or in what lies between him and God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional professional usage concerning acceptance of another person's account or judgment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To confirm or vindicate a person in what he has sworn.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of affirming the status or reliability of a swearer.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To appoint someone as ruler, governor, or manager, or to place something under his possession or authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II causative use of conferring governance, ownership, or control.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Litigation or a mutual proceeding before a judge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized use of the verbal nouns associated with dealing or transacting with another party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand a debt or loan, or to borrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form X verb may be used intransitively for becoming indebted or transitively for seeking a loan from another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death, conceived metaphorically as an inevitable debt that every person must pay.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the ordinary debt sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Harvested produce or fruit described as an amount that is gathered and used to discharge needs or debts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative poetic application rather than the ordinary financial meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An inherited system of usages, rites, ceremonies, and communal ordinances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of traditional practices transmitted from ancestors, including customs of pilgrimage, marriage, inheritance, commerce, and conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A custom, habit, established way, course, or manner of conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This classical usage describes an individual's or group's customary way of acting and may overlap with the sense of habitual practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Business or occupation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical nominal use distinct from the religious sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The management, conduct, or regulation of affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use referring to the ordering or administration of matters.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state, condition, or circumstance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions describing the condition in which a person or thing is found.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A property or characteristic that produces a known effect from an unknown cause.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical usage equated with a special inherent property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Disobedience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal sense explicitly presented as the contrary of obedience.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Retaliation by a corresponding act, such as killing for killing, wounding for wounding, or mutilating for mutilating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized form of requital in which the response corresponds to the injury.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Compulsion, subdual, subjection, dominion, mastership, or possession of authority.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal branch emphasizing imposed power or control over another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disease, especially an old or longstanding disease.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily-affliction noun distinct from the abstract senses of the root.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cause of death.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A feminine nominal form distinct from the broader metaphorical sense of دَيْنٌ as death.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Religious; one who makes himself a servant of God.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of religious commitment or devotional service.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A requiter who neglects no deed but repays it with good or evil.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With the definite article, this is applied as an epithet to God; without that restriction it can describe a human requiter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A subduer or possessor of commanding power.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man, and with the definite article also used as an epithet of God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A judge, ruler, or governor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A title of authority applicable to a human ruler and, with the definite article, to God.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A manager, conductor, or orderer of another person's affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Emphasizes administrative direction rather than judicial requital.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A debtor, borrower, or person who takes a loan or buys on credit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This participial form is reported with opposite financial orientations in different usages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who repays a debt.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attested use that reverses the usual debtor relation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A creditor, lender, or person who grants credit or sells on credit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The person becomes entitled to payment from the other party.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A city or settled urban center.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun is explained through the idea of a place held under authority or governed order.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person intimately acquainted with a place or matter, in the idiom “son of its city.”
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in an idiomatic expression meaning one who knows the place thoroughly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who frequently or extensively gives loans or grants credit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive epithet; the form may be used for a man or woman without a feminine suffix.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who frequently seeks loans, buys on credit, or has many debts.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A contrary financial use of the same intensive epithet.

cautions: The Form I Quran group is attested as the imperfect يَدِينُونَ but is displayed under the normalized perfect citation form دَانَ.
Lane's printed Quran references for the passive participle use historical numbering; the modern example locations here follow the independently supplied QAC locations 37:53 and 56:86.
The passive participle مَدِينٌ has competing Quranic interpretations in the supplied lexical evidence: being requited or reckoned with, and being held under authority.
